name: Global Packs
summary: Utility mod that automatically loads data packs and resource packs from a shared folder into every world, and can force-load listed resource packs. The pack uses it as plumbing rather than a gameplay feature.
editor_notes: Jar description is a template placeholder; behavior taken from Modrinth body. Possibly overlaps with Paxi, which the pack uses to ship its datapacks - verify which handles what.
